videos.caption: Despite the stereotype that cats and dogs are natural enemies, many kittens and dogs can become close companions. Their relationship depends heavily on temperament, past experiences, and how they are introduced. Dogs that are calm around cats and kittens that have positive early exposure to dogs are more likely to develop a peaceful relationship. Young animals can be especially adaptable. Research on mixed cat-and-dog households has found that earlier introductions are associated with more positive relationships, and some pairs eventually sleep together, play, groom one another, and seek each other out for companionship.
